command:
set -euo pipefail
echo DEFAULT_SINK=$(pactl get-default-sink 2>/dev/null || true)
echo DEFAULT_SOURCE=$(pactl get-default-source 2>/dev/null || true)
echo SINKS
pactl list short sinks 2>/dev/null || true
echo SOURCES
pactl list short sources 2>/dev/null || true
echo SOUNDDEVICE
python3 - <<'PY'
import sounddevice as sd, json
out=[]
for i,d in enumerate(sd.query_devices()):
 out.append({'i':i,'name':d['name'],'in':d['max_input_channels'],'out':d['max_output_channels'],'default_low_in':d['default_low_input_latency'],'default_low_out':d['default_low_output_latency']})
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
print('default='+json.dumps(sd.default.device))
PY
